## Optional Guard contribution guide

If you maintain this project and want to contribute an optional HOL Guard
profile for its CLI or MCP operations, you can request a project-specific
Extension Builder guide below. You review the generated files and submit your
own contribution PR. Local Guard protection is free and needs no account;
contributed profiles stay off until users enable them.
